name: Sotillo de la Adrada (Spain)
description: Square crimson flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Sotillo de la Adrada on a white panel (a crescent over a castle, a fleur-de-lis and pines).
history: The arms were approved officially on 23 March 1994 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 63 of 4 April 1994) and the flag on 6 May 1999 (no. 96 of 21 May 1999); the flag is square of proportion 1:1, crimson, with the municipal arms in its metals and enamels on a white ground at the centre.

features.role: Sotillo de la Adrada arms — crescent, castle, fleur-de-lis and pines
